beats.say: About five to seven metres. That's how high the sea can surge where the Krishna and Godavari meet the Bay.
beats.caption: Bapatla–Kakinada: surge of 5–7 m possible (IMD)

beats.say: India's weather office calls it a very high risk zone.
beats.caption: IMD: Very High Risk Zone

beats.say: For Murasu, it warned of a surge up to one and a half metres, worst around Bapatla and Krishna.
beats.caption: Murasu: peak surge 1–1.5 m forecast

beats.say: Two river mouths. After a cyclone in nineteen ninety, satellites saw water still standing in the Krishna delta eleven days later.
beats.caption: May 1990: standing water seen after 11 days

beats.say: In nineteen seventy-seven, a cyclone struck Divi Seema. About ten thousand people died. The surge was blamed.
beats.caption: 1977 Divi Seema: about 10,000 dead · blamed on the surge

beats.say: One and a half metres this time. About five to seven is possible. Is the delta ready?
beats.caption: 1.5 m this time · 5–7 m possible
